notes.title: Major Update - 2
notes.content:
Hello Players
Major Update 2 is live. We're back with exciting updates for our game Speedy Gun Savage. This one has most of the things our community asked for and we are continuously working to evolve the universe of Wolf. It has new game modes, new achievements, in-game leaderboards, extended map details and bug fixes.

We are excited to introduce [b]Challenge mode[/b] in this update:

Starting with a challenge which has cowboys written all over it, [b]Duel challenge[/b]. Take your pistol and shoot the enemy before he shoots you and gets the satisfaction of EKIA. Duel for 3 rounds to complete the challenge and come out as the shooting from hip cowboy you are. Top the leaderboard. If you lose then try again and if you win, win again to unlock more achievements and be the biggest badass cowboy on the leaderboard. 
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/37Sybl3dj1sFZSJeep/giphy.gif[/img]

Secondly a challenge fit for the gun blazing, hell raising cowboy and that is [b]Wave challenge[/b]. Get your guns and shoot'em up before they kill you. Kill whatever moves. As the player you'll get to experience free roaming system in this challenge mode, remember to use your joysticks to move around and kill'em all. Keep time consideration as well cause time plays big role on the leaderboard. Keep shooting and winning to earn new achievements and top the leaderboard.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/dwtXAfC5otYN0IkrMj/giphy.gif[/img]

Access [b]Hall of Fame[/b] in Game and see where you stand amongst the Speedy Gun Savage players all around the globe and amongst your friends. Top the leaderboards to unlock new achievements.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/150f91saE2CIrtKOCj/giphy.gif[/img]

With updated [b]world informatics and transition[/b] now you get more insights about the planet and the standing in leaderboard. Check the stories and your standings while going to another planet.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/wnA8K34Ja6dcf0cTZa/giphy.gif[/img]

[u][b]Patch Notes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Introducing Challenges
[*] Duel Challenge
[*] Wave Challenge
[*] In-game leaderboards and HoF
[*] New Achievements
[*] Updated World informatics
[*] (fix) Flying skulls no longer get stuck at one place
[*] (fix) Hanging Ghouls now deal damage
[*] (fix) Rare crash issue, where a checkpoint could potentially crash the game
[*] (Balancing update) Recalibrated ammo for challenge mode
[/list]

[b]Cheers![/b]
Team Gamitronics

Join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/cCyrbbSXxa

notes.title: Major Update - 1
notes.content:
Hello Players
Major Update 1 is live. Almost a month has passed since the launch of Speedy Gun Savage in Early Access. During this period we've interacted with our players, collected feedback and have addressed them in the game.

After recovering from the blow of Covid-19 we've resumed our work and are producing full throttle now.  The new update majorly includes following:
[list]
[*] Haptics
[*] Improved Audio
[/list]

We hope that this will add into the experience and show our passion for the game.

We had received feedback on audio fx and we've taken that into consideration and have improved by adding up on spatial audio and stuff which will improve the existing experience.

We have included haptics in this one as we wanted to synchronize and make haptics feel as good as the shots you're firing from the guns.

[u][b]Patch Notes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Added Haptic feedback on shooting
[*] Improved spatial audio
[*] Added more attenuators to improve experience
[*] Demons now give you critical score
[*] Skeletons don't attack from behind when on cart
[*] (Fix) If you die on zipline it no longer gives you scrolling game over screen
[*] (Fix) No more zombie skeletons, at times skeletons would attack you even after dying in cave cart level 
[*] (Fix) Rare collision issue, player character would rarely get stuck in checkpoint in scifi level
[*] (Balancing Update) Boss fights now have both the pickups
[/list]

We'll keep working and adding new features in the game.

Cheers!
[b]Team Gamitronics[/b]

Join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/cCyrbbSXxa

notes.title: Working our way through Covid
notes.content:
Second wave of Covid-19 in India came to us and said Hello! and half of our team tested positive. We're working our way through this and trying to deliver bundles of joy to our players but there are some delays. We're expecting things to settle down in a week or so, we'll be back with timely updates for our players.

Stay Safe!
Cheers!
Team Gamitronics

notes.title: Out Now
notes.content:
Gamitronics are excited to reveal that their gunslinging space western VR-exclusive Speedy Gun Savage is out today on Steam Early Access for $9.99. 


[previewyoutube=sOA4s33xFik;full][/previewyoutube]

Speedy Gun Savage is an arcade shooter putting players in the gunslinging boots of alien bounty hunter Wolf as they embark on a quest through three stages of futuristic, western-inspired shootouts. Joined by their robot sidekick 3V4N, Speedy Gun Savage features a dynamic cover system, three guns, over a dozen enemy types, and three planets each with multiple levels and with their own unique bosses. Each stage offers replayability with online leaderboards as players hone their gunslinging game in this steampunk adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39886904/4b25a1c34b64a65e2f16bdd1800486fd3e1f72b5.gif[/img]
